title: Mikey Whipwreck’s unlikely partnership with Cactus Jack
summary: An inexperienced underdog becomes Cactus Jack’s surprise championship partner. Their success gives Mikey credibility long before he can reliably win on his own.

chapters.title: The unlikely team wins gold
chapters.result: Cactus and Mikey defeat Public Enemy for the tag titles.
chapters.context: Mikey’s unexpected success becomes a key step in his underdog story.

chapters.title: Public Enemy regains the belts
chapters.result: Public Enemy defeats Cactus and Mikey for the tag championships.
chapters.context: The first reign ends, but the partnership has established Mikey as more than an easy opponent.
